timestamp_method: source_frame_index / source_fps, nominal playback time; not camera timestamps
entry_origin_position: integer box center; first 20 processed frames count as ALREADY PRESENT
dwell_position: float box bottom center; manually inspect whether legacy zones fit these foot points
limitations: No camera-motion compensation or physical calibration
All trajectories retained even if excluded by counting filter
Detector confidence is not confidence in identity or query answer
